h1: Land Rover Engine Rebuild Warranty Explained
lede: What our 12-month unlimited-mileage rebuild warranty actually covers - and what it doesn't

sections.heading: What a Professional Engine Rebuild Warranty Covers

blocks.html: Every engine rebuild we complete at Land Rover Garage comes with a **12-month unlimited-mileage warranty** on parts and workmanship. This is our guarantee that the work we've done meets the standards we set for ourselves - and that we'll put it right if something goes wrong.
All internal engine components replaced during the rebuild - pistons, camshafts, bearings, valve assemblies, timing chains, timing gears, oil pump, crankshaft, and gaskets.
If a warrantied component fails, we cover the labour to diagnose, remove, repair, and refit - you don't pay for our time to fix our work.
Unlike many engine warranties that cap coverage at 12,000 or 30,000 miles, our warranty has **no mileage limit** during the 12-month term.
If you sell your Land Rover during the warranty period, the warranty may be transferable to the new owner - subject to our standard inspection terms.

Our warranty is governed by the **Consumer Rights Act 2015** and aligns with **BS AU257:2002**, the British Standard for remanufactured engines. That means you have statutory protection in addition to our own guarantee.

paras: **Every rebuild we complete carries this warranty** - from a classic Defender 200Tdi through to a modern L663 D300. The warranty is the same regardless of the engine family, because our rebuild process is designed to the same standard across every Land Rover we work on.
**Engine rebuilds start from £1,900** - all rebuilds include our 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty as standard.
All prices include parts, labour, and machining. [Pricing disclaimer](/pricing-legal-disclaimer) applies. No hidden fees.

blocks.html: Your final price depends on your specific Land Rover model, engine family, and the condition of the engine once it's inspected. We quote after inspection - not before - so you only pay for the work your engine actually needs, not a generic estimate that doesn't reflect the real condition.

sections.heading: How Our Rebuild & Warranty Process Works

steps.title: Recovery & Arrival
steps.body: We recover your Land Rover to our workshop in Billericay, Essex. Most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

steps.title: Full Inspection & Quote
steps.body: We strip and inspect the engine to identify exactly what it needs. You get a fixed-price quote before any work begins.

steps.title: Rebuild & Machining
steps.body: We machine, replace, and reassemble to factory specifications. All work is done in-house using Land Rover-specialist tooling.

steps.title: Testing & Quality Control
steps.body: Every rebuilt engine is tested before refitting - and again after the engine is back in your Land Rover, with a full road test.

steps.title: Warranty Registration
steps.body: Your 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty is registered immediately on completion. You receive full documentation with your vehicle.

steps.title: Warranty Support
steps.body: If you need to make a claim, we handle it directly - no third-party warranty companies, no runaround.

sections.heading: Why Land Rover Owners Choose Our Workshop

We work on Land Rovers every day - from classic Defenders to the latest L663 generation. We know the engines inside out.
We don't outsource our machining or assembly. Every stage of the rebuild happens under one roof, with our own quality control.

We collect your Land Rover from anywhere in the UK. Most vehicles are recovered within a few hours of booking.
We quote after full inspection, so you know exactly what you're paying before any work starts. No hidden extras, no "while we're in there" surprises.
We've been rebuilding Land Rover engines for over 15 years. Our workshop is purpose-built for Land Rover engine work, and our team knows the brand.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Our Warranty

items.q: What exactly does the 12-month warranty cover?
items.a: Our warranty covers all internal engine components replaced during the rebuild - pistons, camshafts, bearings, valve assemblies, timing chains, timing gears, oil pump, crankshaft, and gaskets. It also covers the labour to diagnose and repair any warrantied failure. Wear items not part of the rebuild (spark plugs, filters, belts, hoses) are not covered.

items.q: Is the warranty unlimited mileage or capped?
items.a: **Unlimited mileage.** Unlike many engine warranties that cap coverage at 12,000 or 30,000 miles, our warranty has no mileage limit during the 12-month term.

items.q: What isn't covered by the warranty?
items.a: The warranty does not cover failures caused by improper maintenance, incorrect oil or coolant, overheating, neglect, or accident. It also doesn't cover lacquered valves or failures due to carbon deposits - these are the result of how the engine has been run and maintained, not a defect in our workmanship.

items.q: Is the warranty transferable if I sell my Land Rover?
items.a: Yes - subject to our standard inspection terms. If you sell your Land Rover during the warranty period, the warranty may be transferred to the new owner. Contact us to arrange the transfer.

items.q: Do I need to register my warranty?
items.a: We register the warranty for you on completion of your rebuild. You don't need to fill out any forms - your warranty certificate is provided with your vehicle and is valid from the date of completion.

items.q: How do I make a warranty claim?
items.a: Contact us directly by phone or email. We'll arrange for your Land Rover to be recovered to our workshop (if needed), inspect the engine, and carry out the repair work. We handle claims directly - no third-party warranty companies involved.

items.q: Does the warranty cover engines fitted by other garages?
items.a: No - the warranty only covers engines rebuilt and fitted by Land Rover Garage. We stand behind our own work, but we cannot guarantee the quality of work done by other garages.

items.q: What's the difference between our warranty and a manufacturer warranty?
items.a: Our warranty is a specialist workshop warranty covering the engine rebuild work we've carried out. It's not a manufacturer's new-vehicle warranty, and it doesn't cover the rest of the vehicle. However, it does give you the same 12-month coverage on the engine itself that you'd expect from any reputable specialist.
